description:
Get a free API key
Create a free account for an email address and get an API key for the paid stories tools. Returns `{email, token, detail}`: send `token` as the API key on later calls. It works at once for 30 queries/month, rising to 300/month after the user clicks the verification link that is emailed to them. If the email is already verified, returns 403 and emails the existing key instead. Only call this with the user's own email and their consent. Not needed if you pay per call with x402. Free: no API key or payment needed.
name: api_key_create
